targets.title: E01/Ex01 partition selection workflow
targets.expectation: GUI and CLI expose preflight, dependency, partition selection, extraction, and provenance evidence.

targets.title: Volume Shadow Copy direct discovery and extraction
targets.expectation: Discover, mount, compare, and extract VSC snapshots from an image workflow, not only already-mounted folders.

targets.title: Windows file-system inventory
targets.expectation: Extract file rows with metadata, source path, hashes, deleted/recovery hints, and report citations.

targets.title: $MFT deep parser
targets.expectation: Decode record headers, attributes, runlists, parent path reconstruction, deleted state, and trusted diff evidence.

targets.title: $UsnJrnl replay
targets.expectation: Decode USN v2/v3/v4 records, replay rename/delete events, maintain FRN path cache, and support large journals.

targets.title: EVTX native BinXML parser
targets.expectation: Native EVTX parsing covers file/chunk/record/BinXML structures, message rendering, recovery, and trusted diffs.

targets.title: Registry transaction replay and key tree
targets.expectation: Reconstruct hives with LOG1/LOG2 replay, full key tree, user activity pivots, and source offsets.

targets.title: Registry deleted key/value recovery
targets.expectation: Recover and score deleted keys/values with allocator false-positive controls and report limitations.

targets.title: SAM/SECURITY/SYSTEM account and privilege parser
targets.expectation: Parse users, groups, aliases, LSA policy, privileges, mounted devices, services, and control sets.

targets.title: Windows execution artifacts
targets.expectation: Parse Amcache, ShimCache, BAM/DAM, UserAssist, Tasks, WMI, WER, Defender, Firewall, and service evidence.

targets.title: Prefetch parser
targets.expectation: Decode Prefetch versions and compressed PF metadata with execution metrics and referenced files.

targets.title: ShellBags parser
targets.expectation: Decode NTUSER/UsrClass ShellBags, BagMRU/Bags relationships, timestamps, deleted/slack evidence, and source cells.

targets.title: LNK and JumpList parser
targets.expectation: Decode ShellLink and DestList structures, targets, tracker GUIDs, AppID, deleted entries, and MRU state.

targets.title: USB and removable device timeline
targets.expectation: Correlate registry USB traces, mounted devices, users, volume GUIDs, and file activity into a timeline.

targets.title: Recycle Bin parser
targets.expectation: Parse $I/$R entries with original path, deletion time, SID/user mapping, hashes, and source citations.

targets.title: Alternate Data Stream inventory
targets.expectation: Inventory Zone.Identifier and suspicious named ADS exports with stream hashes, host correlation, risk scoring, and source locators.

targets.title: Thumbnail and icon cache parser
targets.expectation: Parse Windows thumbnail/icon cache entries, image hashes, source locators, and review thumbnails.

targets.title: Activities, notifications, clipboard, and UWP artifacts
targets.expectation: Parse ActivitiesCache, notifications, clipboard-like residues, ConnectedDevicesPlatform, and UWP app traces.

targets.title: Browser history and downloads
targets.expectation: Parse Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari history/downloads with unified timestamp semantics and source citations.

targets.title: Browser cache, session, extension, sync, cookie, and credential stores
targets.expectation: Inventory and legally gate sensitive browser stores, with deep decoders where safe and validated.

targets.title: AI service transcript parser
targets.expectation: Parse ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and other AI Q/A from exports and browser stores.

targets.title: Email parser
targets.expectation: Parse PST/OST/MBOX/MSG/EML with folders, threads, deleted items, attachments, and header graph.

targets.title: Archive and encrypted container inventory
targets.expectation: Inventory ZIP/RAR/7z evidence files, encrypted entries, traversal risk, nested containers, executable entries, and safe extraction blockers.

targets.title: Google Takeout and Google cloud export parser
targets.expectation: Parse Gmail, Drive, Photos, Activity, Location, and account/device context from Takeout exports.

targets.title: iCloud export parser
targets.expectation: Parse iCloud Photos, albums, shares, devices, account metadata, and EXIF context.

targets.title: Microsoft 365, OneDrive, Teams, SharePoint export parser
targets.expectation: Parse Graph/eDiscovery exports, Teams messages/reactions/attachments, OneDrive files, and SharePoint permissions.

targets.title: Cloud API acquisition
targets.expectation: Collect authorized cloud API data with OAuth/device flow, pagination, backoff, redaction, and audit.

targets.title: PC KakaoTalk parser
targets.expectation: Analyze legacy and post-patch PC KakaoTalk data, rooms, messages, media, key-store metadata, and memory-assisted residues.

targets.title: iOS backup parser
targets.expectation: Parse Manifest.db, domains, media, SMS, app DBs, keychain inventory, and encrypted-backup legal workflow.

targets.title: Android artifact parser
targets.expectation: Parse Android SMS, call log, contacts, browser, media, app DBs, packages, signatures, and permissions.

targets.title: Messenger schema matrix
targets.expectation: Support KakaoTalk, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat, Discord, Instagram, and export/native schema versions.

targets.title: Mobile unified contact/call/SMS/message view
targets.expectation: Correlate contacts, calls, SMS, messages, media, and file-system artifacts with entity resolution.

targets.title: Image gallery and metadata review
targets.expectation: Review images with EXIF, metadata, thumbnails, tagging, hash/citation, and gallery navigation.

targets.title: EXIF GPS map review
targets.expectation: Surface photo EXIF GPS, image datetime, map markers, source hashes, and citation blockers for map/timeline review.

targets.title: Video/audio preview and transcript
targets.expectation: Preview video/audio safely with thumbnails, waveform, transcript cues, hashes, and report citations.

targets.title: OCR pipeline
targets.expectation: Run OCR queue, retry, Korean OCR calibration, translation sidecar, confidence, and searchable results.

targets.title: Document and database viewer
targets.expectation: Search and review Office/PDF/text/SQLite/DB files with table paging, deleted rows, and citations.

targets.title: Archive and encrypted-file workflow
targets.expectation: Detect archives/encrypted files, safely recurse, manage password candidates, and sandbox previews.

targets.title: File carving
targets.expectation: Carve bounded signature candidates with offsets, hashes, recovery caveats, and large-case queue controls.

targets.title: Memory analysis
targets.expectation: Inventory memory dumps and parse process/network/module/handle/credential-yielding artifacts where authorized.

targets.title: LotL and fileless activity
targets.expectation: Correlate PowerShell, WMI, WMIC, scheduled tasks, registry, event logs, services, and script evidence.

targets.title: WebShell and server log analysis
targets.expectation: Parse web roots, IIS/Apache/Nginx logs, suspicious source files, webshell rule hits, and source viewers.

targets.title: IOC and threat-intelligence enrichment
targets.expectation: Extract indicators and enrich with local signed feeds, STIX/TAXII, confidence decay, and no-network policy.

targets.title: External tool import and trusted diff
targets.expectation: Import and compare EvtxECmd, Hayabusa, RECmd, MFTECmd, JLECmd, PECmd, ShellBagsExplorer, and SRUM/ESE outputs.

targets.title: Source viewers
targets.expectation: Provide source-backed EVTX, registry, hex, SQLite, email, image/video, OCR, timeline, and text viewers.

targets.title: Unified search
targets.expectation: Search files, docs, browser, AI, EVTX, registry, OCR, email, messenger, cloud, and timeline with source verification.

targets.title: Review workflow
targets.expectation: Support relevant, needs-review, excluded, include-in-report, tags, notes, evidence tray, compare, shortcuts, and history.

targets.title: Unified timeline correlation
targets.expectation: Merge all artifacts into a cursor-friendly timeline with timezone, skew, and citation overlays.

targets.title: Report and court exhibit bundle
targets.expectation: Export selected evidence, citations, hashes, parser versions, limitations, audit chain, and exhibit package.

targets.title: Large-case performance
targets.expectation: Handle 100k/1M/10M rows with cursor APIs, checkpoint/resume, parser crash isolation, memory caps, and benchmarks.

targets.title: Taxonomy audit guardrail
targets.expectation: Fail when a target forensic artifact has no collector, artifact type, viewer, test, or documentation mapping.
